publicationPolicy.dataset: Coordinator confirms a freshly seeded fictional-only test database; synthetic UUIDs are retained for exact selection and return relationships.
publicationPolicy.includes: Allowlisted report fields, geometry, statuses including failures/unrun, hashes, selected root-level PNGs, and a separate CI receipt.
publicationPolicy.excludes: No recursive directory copies; no private browser profiles, environment or lease files, session cookies, network bodies, freeform DOM/answer text, or local filesystem paths.
publicationPolicy.errors: Failure first lines and original-error SHA-256 are retained; multiline assertion bodies are excluded because they can contain network records.
publicationPolicy.urls: Local test URLs retain allowlisted navigation fields and identity anchors; other query values and external/credential-bearing URLs are omitted.
publicationPolicy.pngs: Selected PNG bytes are copied unchanged with SHA-256 receipts. No screenshot is fabricated for a missing or failed capture.
